word: Title: The Soup That Refused to Behave
answer: La Sopa Que Se Negó a Comportarse

word: A watery broth splashes over the stove.
answer: Un caldo aguado salpica sobre la estufa.

word: A smoky aroma rises from the pot.
answer: Un aroma ahumado sube de la olla.

word: A sharp-image photo guides my recipe steps.
answer: Una foto nítida guía mis pasos de receta.

word: A flat-tasting spoonful disappoints my expectations.
answer: Una cucharada desabrida decepciona mis expectativas.

word: A greasy film floats across the surface.
answer: Una capa aceitoso flota sobre la superficie.

word: We are going to thicken the bland mixture.
answer: Vamos a espesar la mezcla insípida.

word: A pointed ladle taps the metal rim.
answer: Un cucharón puntiagudo golpea el borde metálico.

word: A burned-tasting chunk hides near the bottom.
answer: Un pedazo tostado se esconde cerca del fondo.

word: A fizzy splash escapes from the carbonated drink.
answer: Un chorro gaseoso escapa de la bebida carbonatada.

word: A melted pat of butter swirls into ribbons.
answer: Una porción derretida de mantequilla forma cintas.

word: We are going to replace the flat drink.
answer: Vamos a reemplazar la bebida desgasificada.

word: A blurry reflection wobbles on the lid.
answer: Un reflejo borroso tiembla sobre la tapa.

word: A thick swirl forms around the vegetables.
answer: Un remolino espeso se forma alrededor de las verduras.

word: A dull-blade knife struggles with the carrots.
answer: Un cuchillo desafilado lucha con las zanahorias.

word: A ripe tomato bursts under gentle pressure.
answer: Un tomate maduro revienta bajo presión suave.

word: We are going to strain the oily broth.
answer: Vamos a colar el caldo oleoso.

word: A thin-liquid drizzle runs down the handle.
answer: Un goteo líquido corre por el mango.

word: An overripe pepper softens too quickly today.
answer: Un pimiento pasado se ablanda demasiado rápido hoy.

word: A solidified lump refuses to dissolve fully.
answer: Un grumo cuajado se niega a disolverse por completo.

word: I am going to finish this stubborn soup.
answer: Voy a terminar esta sopa terca.
